title: Controller & harness
summary: The missing layer above skills and agents provides execution state and enforceable controls.

sections.label: Design boundary
sections.text: A prompt can describe a rule. The runtime must enforce permissions, state changes, and budget controls. A skill does not create durable execution or prove successful completion.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Separate controller, harness and instruction responsibilities while choosing the design.
Identify which runtime component enforces each permission, state transition and budget.
Keep any enforcement described only in a prompt marked unimplemented.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

catalog.applicability: Use when deciding which layer owns execution state, permissions and budget controls in an agent setup. A prompt or skill can describe a rule, but the runtime has to enforce it.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
